_note: Editorial scores for the demo market xx (fictional). Each criterion 0-10 with a one-line reason; the overall score is computed from the blueprint weights. Bonuses are scored here because the demo market allows promotions. Every review needs at least one con.

marlowe.summary: The most complete all-rounder: strong live tables, phone support and fair bonus terms.
marlowe.verdict: Marlowe Club does everything well and nothing badly. Card withdrawals took about four hours in our tests, slower than Nyxa's Apple Pay payouts.

safety.reason: Licence shown in the footer; deposit limits offered at sign-up.

payouts.reason: Card withdrawals arrived in 3 to 5 hours across five tests.

games.reason: About 2,600 games with a good mix of large and small studios.

live.reason: 130 live tables, including low-stake roulette all night.

app.reason: Stable app on iOS and Android; game search could be faster.

support.reason: 24h chat plus a phone line that answered in under a minute.

bonuses.reason: Welcome offer with 1× wagering on the bonus, terms on one page.

pros: Low 1× wagering on the welcome offer

nyxa.summary: Fastest payouts we measured and a big slot library; live casino is thin.
nyxa.verdict: Nyxa pays fastest: Apple Pay withdrawals landed in about a quarter of an hour. Its live casino is small and there is no phone support.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; identity check before the first withdrawal only.

payouts.reason: Apple Pay withdrawals in 10 to 20 minutes, cards in about 2 hours.

games.reason: About 3,300 games with clear filters and RTP shown.

live.reason: 70 live tables, few open late at night.

app.reason: Quick app with deposit and limits two taps away.

support.reason: 24h chat replied in 3 minutes; no phone line.

bonuses.reason: Generous welcome offer but 30× wagering on bonus funds.

verazul.summary: Strong live casino and quick card payouts, smaller slot library.
verazul.verdict: Verazul pairs 150 live tables with card withdrawals in about 90 minutes. Chat closes at midnight and the slot range is narrower.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; clear terms, but verification took a day.

app.reason: Full-featured app; too many notifications by default.

support.reason: Chat from 8:00 to midnight; phone line available.

bonuses.reason: Cashback on live losses with no wagering, small welcome offer.

lunaro.summary: The biggest live casino in the list; few slots and short support hours.
lunaro.verdict: Lunaro is built for live players: 220 tables, many open around the clock. Slot fans have better options, and support closes at 21:00.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; limit tools easy to find.

live.reason: 220 live tables, the largest selection we tested.

app.reason: Light app; live streams stayed smooth on 4G.

support.reason: Chat 9:00 to 21:00; email answered in two days.

bonuses.reason: Live-only welcome offer; slots do not count toward wagering.

cobaltio.summary: Largest game library, but slow bank-only payouts and no app.
cobaltio.verdict: Cobaltio has the biggest catalogue here, over 4,500 games. Withdrawals go by bank transfer only and took two days; there is no app.

safety.reason: Licence displayed; responsible-gambling page is incomplete.

payouts.reason: Bank withdrawals only, about 48 hours each time.

games.reason: Over 4,500 games, the largest selection we tested.

app.reason: No app; the mobile site works but loads slowly.

support.reason: 24h chat answered quickly and knew the terms.

bonuses.reason: Weekly free spins with no wagering on winnings.
